hidden_assets.purpose: Rate constant ratio windows (bulk vs tubes)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: polymerization 18× slower in (10,10) and 50× slower in (7,7); windows 18±9 and 50±25 per approved plan.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly traceable to the paper's reported relative rates.

outputs.description: Weight-averaged molecular weight evolution data. The checker verifies monotonic increase, plateau in confined systems, and correct ordering (bulk > (10,10) > (7,7)) at comparable times.

Fitted second-order polymerization rate constants. The checker checks ordering and that the ratio of bulk to tube rates falls within the paper's reported factor windows (18±9 for (10,10), 50±25 for (7,7)).
Activation energies from Arrhenius analysis. The checker verifies that the activation energies fall within the paper-reported error bars: 52–78 kcal/mol (bulk), 44–60 ((10,10)), 49–59 ((7,7)).

steps.description: Verify Mw vs time: monotonic increase per (system,temperature), plateau for tube systems, ordering bulk > (10,10) > (7,7) at comparable times.
Check rate constants ordering and ratio windows.
Check activation energies within paper-reported error bars.
